title: Coherence of the recorded module pullback tensor comparison
statement: Let $g:T\to X$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Equip module sheaves with their sheaf tensor [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. Let $F:\operatorname{Mod}(O_X)\to\operatorname{Mod}(O_T)$ be a functor, with object identifications $h_M:F(M)=g^*M$ and arrow formula $F(a)=h_M;g^*(a);h_N^{-1}$ for the tensor-formula pullback [def-pc-module-pullback]. Write $e_{M,N}:g^*(M\otimes N)\cong g^*M\otimes g^*N$ for Classical.choose of the recorded comparison [lem-weil-pbc-module-pullback-tensor]. Then there exists a strong monoidal structure $m_F$ on $F$ whose inverse tensorator is $h_{M\otimes N};e_{M,N};(h_M^{-1}\otimes h_N^{-1})$. This statement concerns module sheaves only, not derived categories.

proof.text: Prove equality of maps out of a tensor sheaf by the sheafification adjunction and induction on pure tensors. For three factors, apply this first to the outer pair. The inner tensorator to the forgetful presheaf is locally surjective; restrict an inner section to a covering sieve where it lifts to the presheaf tensor. Tensor induction there reduces to triple pure tensors, and separatedness of the target sheaf descends equality. These are private, fully proved extensionality helpers in the delivered module.

Apply the chosen tensor-pullback adjunction to the two associativity composites, then use triple-tensor extensionality. The section formula for the chosen comparison, naturality of the adjunction unit and the associator section formula rewrite both sides to the same pure triple tensor of pulled-back sections.

Use tensorPullbackObjUnitToUnit and its proved isomorphism and adjunction-unit characterization. Apply the pullback adjunction to each inverse-unit diagram. Naturality moves the inverse unitor to the source section, where it inserts 1. The comparison section formula separates the two pulled-back sections, and the structure-sheaf comparison sends the pulled-back 1 to 1 because the scheme ring map preserves 1. The target inverse unitor inserts exactly this same 1, proving both diagrams on every section.

Specialize the recorded comparison naturality to an identity in each variable and rewrite tensoring with identity as whiskering. Build CoreMonoidal with CoreMonoidal.mk', using the inverse comparison and the inverse of the structure-sheaf isomorphism. Form F ≅ tensorPullback g from eqToIso(hF) and prove naturality using hmap. Transport the monoidal structure along its inverse with coreMonoidalTransport; the inverse tensorator equation is then reflexive.
